description: This file declares external APIs for the TOD Client Object in the ANSC framework, including functions for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing TOD client objects.

methods.name: AnscCreateTodClient
methods.description: Creates a new TOD client with specified container and owner contexts.

methods.name: AnscTodcoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the TOD client object.

methods.name: AnscTodcoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the TOD client instance.

methods.name: AnscTodcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects for the TOD client to function.
